verdict.rationale: Superset is a coding-agent orchestrator, so the AI output comes from third-party CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) that it runs against your repository. Inside the product you can launch those agents from a prompt, schedule recurring runs, review what they did in a diff viewer, and share agent-created reports. It has no first-party feature that analyzes your data and proactively surfaces insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: native AI insight or suggestion generation, proactive analysis of user data beyond prompting an external agent, and independent corroboration of insight or report quality.
